paper_id: Xiao et al. - 2006 - Mutual anonymous overlay multicast
title: Mutual anonymous overlay multicast
venue: Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing
motivation: Multicast services缺乏anon支持；军事/应急/商务应用需要发送方和接收方互相隐藏身份
problem_framing: 将multicast anon问题形式化为AM-NM/AM-AM连接和树结构anon度分析
key_insight: 匿名multicast必须围绕树结构而非多播unicast；invite MO节点可将AM比例控制在~50%阈值以保持效率
method_signature: MAM协议含AM-NM单向anon、AM-AM双向anon协议及树构造与MO邀请优化
evaluation_criteria: RRU相对资源使用率和AWD最坏延迟与Optimal/RAND基准对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 若所有成员都是AM，即使最优解也和RAND一样差；过多AM-AM连接需invite MO节点补救
evidence_for_taste: cannot be directly applied to multicast
centers on the concept of the tree
a set of unicast communications is inefficient
average cost is at least two times greater
significant bandwidth efficiency can be achieved with little sacrifice
inviting more MO nodes is not as effective
thinking_moves: 识别multicast anon与unicast anon的根本差异在于group关系和树结构暴露风险
将anon协议按连接类型分层设计(AM-NM/AM-AM/MO)以解耦复杂性
通过数值分析揭示broken ratio/树度/深度与anon度的数学关联
用IT阈值(≈50%)将协议开销与性能做工程权衡
先证incomplete tree可获高带宽效率且anon度损失小，再用于仿真验证
cites_own_work: Xiao et al. - 2006 - A design of overlay anonymous multicast protocol
Xiao et al. - 2003 - Low-cost and reliable mutual anonymity protocols
